'''Ajoha Jeh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] biologist who worked on developing special implants that would enable better exploration of toxic worlds during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Jeh hired outside help to test her implants on the toxic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], and gave the prototypes as payment after a successful test.<ref name="Mission" />
